summary.text: Joseph Sanchez is a Democratic state representative from District 40 who has represented the district since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the New Mexico House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An electrical engineer by training, he worked at Los Alamos National Laboratory and led the Jemez Mountains Electric Cooperative.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Sanchez earned a B.S. in electrical engineering and an M.S. in electrical engineering from the University of New Mexico, and an M.B.A. from New Mexico State University.
His career includes work as an electrical engineer and engineering manager at Los Alamos National Laboratory and service as general manager and CEO of the Jemez Mountains Electric Cooperative.

For 2025-2026 Sanchez is assigned to the Appropriations and Finance Committee, the Commerce and Economic Development Committee, and the Local Government, Land Grants and Cultural Affairs Committee, where he is vice chair.
